proofLimits: W01 uses the actual published worker under a controlled SW-owned request header hold. W02/W03 use exact source on owned loopback with native partial HTTP bodies/cache/offline behavior.
Twenty-two anonymous source-byte asset observations bind the published files before/after. Loopback streaming is not relabeled hosted runtime, and controlled faults are not a natural outage.
The nineteen focused Node VM cases are separate recorded local evidence; no old learning or VM suite is repeated here.
Only Playwright1.64.1 is installed in owned runner storage. Chromium Linux system packages belong to the disposable runner.
Exit/close/EOF/groups and same-UID owned browser binary/profile paths plus Linux starttime prove scoped cleanup, not a host-wide inventory.
No native Cache.put stall is forced in browser; that finite-maintenance boundary has separate VM evidence. Physical devices, calendar delivery and full-product acceptance remain outside this packet.
